Name: Main Controller
Description: EVAL BOARD FOR ESP-WROOM-32

Name: Base Rotary Servo
Description: High-torque servo motor to provide rotational input to the planetary gear system.

Name: Shoulder Joint Servo
Description: High-torque servo motor to provide rotational input to the planetary gear system.

Name: Elbow Joint Servo
Description: High-torque servo motor to provide rotational input to the planetary gear system.

Name: Gripper Actuation Servo
Description: SG-90 ANALOG SERVO

Name: Main Power Supply
Description: Provides stable 5V DC power for the ESP32 microcontroller and the WS2812B LED strip.

Name: Power Distribution Board
Description: Distributes 12V power from the battery to high-power components.

Name: Base Plate
Description: Sturdy base for the robotic arm, providing stability and mounting points for the first joint and electronics.

Name: Base Servo Mount
Description: Mount for the base servo to attach to the base plate, allowing for horizontal rotation of the first arm segment.

Name: Arm Segment 1 (Shoulder Link)
Description: Connects the base joint to the shoulder joint, forming the first major link of the SCARA arm.

Name: Shoulder Servo Mount
Description: Mount for the shoulder servo, integrating it into Arm Segment 1 and connecting to Arm Segment 2.

Name: Arm Segment 2 (Elbow Link)
Description: Connects the shoulder joint to the elbow joint, forming the second major link of the SCARA arm.

Name: Elbow Servo Mount
Description: Mount for the elbow servo, integrating it into Arm Segment 2 and connecting to the wrist/end-effector.

Name: Wrist Plate
Description: Flat plate at the end of Arm Segment 2, serving as the attachment point for the gripper or other end-effector.

Name: Gripper Servo Mount
Description: Mount for the micro servo that actuates the gripper fingers.

Name: 2-Finger Gripper Body
Description: Main frame of the 2-finger gripper, holding the servo and allowing finger attachment.

Name: Gripper Finger (Left)
Description: One of two fingers for the end-effector gripper, designed for light payload manipulation.

Name: Gripper Finger (Right)
Description: One of two fingers for the end-effector gripper, designed for light payload manipulation.

Name: M3x12mm Screws
Description: Standard M3 screws for general assembly of 3D-printed parts and servo mounting.

Name: M3 Nuts
Description: Standard M3 nuts for securing screws.

Name: 608ZZ Ball Bearings
Description: Ball bearings for smooth rotation at high-load joints (e.g., base and shoulder pivots).

Name: Main Controller Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the main microcontroller (ESP32/Arduino Mega) on the base plate.

Name: Power Supply Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the main power supply on the base plate.

Name: Power Distribution Board Mount
Description: Mounting bracket for the power distribution board on the base plate.
